Man beaten to death over loud music at Noida birthday party

A man was beaten to death in Noida's Gejha village after he objected to loud music being played at a birthday party. The incident occurred on Friday when the victim, identified as a PG operator, asked the partygoers to lower the volume. A dispute ensued, leading to the victim being beaten to death by the accused. Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation. Two brothers have been arrested in connection with the murder.
